title: Ankhorage Docker Compose Infrastructure
summary: Adapts portable infrastructure workloads to deterministic Docker Compose projects and lifecycle operations.
purpose: Provide a standalone Docker Compose runtime for local or explicitly verified Docker engines.
responsibilities: Project portable workloads into Compose services, networks, volumes, configs, and execution-only secret references.
Operate the local Docker CLI by default or an injected verified remote control plane.
Map Docker Compose lifecycle outcomes into provider-neutral infrastructure results.
boundaries: Does not define portable infrastructure contracts.
Does not provision Docker engines or authenticate arbitrary remote daemons.
Does not introduce Kubernetes-specific workload concepts.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting Docker Compose as a runtime target.
Developers running portable workloads on a local or trusted remote Docker engine.
useCases: Project a portable workload into a deterministic Compose project.
Apply, inspect, suspend, resume, and delete a Compose-backed runtime.
Inject a verified remote Docker control plane instead of the local CLI.

architecture.role: An infrastructure runtime adapter translating portable workload intent into Docker Compose operations.
invariants: Portable secret values remain execution-only and are not retained in projections.
Remote engines require an explicitly supplied verified control plane.
Compose projections remain free of Kubernetes-specific concepts.

security: Resolved secrets are handled only at the execution boundary.
limitations: Docker engine provisioning is outside this adapter.
